name: Recursive Teaching Dimension / Log Size Ratio
details: For every finite binary class, the recursive teaching dimension is at least its Log Size Ratio.
proof: Let $r=\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H)$ on an $n$-point domain. Samei--Semukhin--Yang--Zilles prove $|\mathcal H|\leq\sum_{i=0}^r\binom ni\leq(n+1)^r$. Thus $r\geq\log(|\mathcal H|)/\log(n+1)$, which is at least $\log(|\mathcal H|-1)/\log(n+1)=\mathrm{LSR}(\mathcal H)$; singleton classes satisfy the conclusion by the catalogue's zero convention.
